question: {Find the value of } frac{sqrt{0.018496}}{sqrt{0.001156}}
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Both decimals have 6 decimal places, so the decimal points cancel out directly.

⇒ √0.018496 ÷ √0.001156 = √(18496 ÷ 1156)

⇒ √16 = 4

**∴ The correct answer is 4.**
